searchTooShort: the search needs at least 3 characters (a show's or a character's name); to find images by mood use browse
rejectOnlyInbox: only candidates in inbox can be thrown away: %s
addNeedsMoods: give at least one mood (--moods), or it can never be found again
pickNone: nothing in the library matches; browse/search can find new ones
refNotFound: not found: %s (either an id in the library or the path of an image under the stickers directory)
prepareNeedsMoodOrRef: give either --mood <mood word> or --ref <id or path>
prepareNone: no sticker matches this mood; none is sent this time
helpBrowse: download candidates of a mood category into inbox
helpSearch: search candidates by show or character name
helpGrab: download a candidate from any image URL
helpInbox: list the candidates waiting to be looked at
helpAdd: take a candidate into the library
helpEdit: change the description, moods, tags, rating
helpRemove: take out of the library (moved to trash)
helpPick: pick one by mood to send
helpPrepare: only pick and ready the file, do not send (for Human Harness's sticker tool)
helpMood: mood words to pick one by
helpRef: an id in the library or the path of an image under the stickers directory
helpChannel: whatsapp turns a GIF into an MP4 animation (gifPlayback=true)
helpUsed: count one use after it went out
wizardAbout: Collects stickers and sends one that fits the mood.
